description: This file provides utility functions for configuring HTTP request options, including handling query parameters, headers, and request configurations within an Angular project.

methods.name: hasRequestConfig
methods.description: Checks if the given configuration object has any of the specific request configuration properties.

methods.name: createDefaultHttpOptions
methods.description: Creates default HTTP options based on provided query parameters or request configuration.

methods.name: defaultHttpOptionsFromParams
methods.description: Generates default HTTP options from query parameters and request configuration.

methods.name: defaultHttpOptionsFromConfig
methods.description: Generates default HTTP options from a request configuration object.

methods.name: defaultHttpOptions
methods.description: Constructs default HTTP options including headers and parameters, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: defaultHttpUploadOptions
methods.description: Constructs default HTTP upload options, primarily for file uploads, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: cleanQueryParams
methods.description: Removes null or undefined entries from query parameters.
